title: Badge — shared definitions for the vtc/badges/* spec family
description:
A Verifiable Trust Community's badges (VTI Community Badges chapter, VTI-BDG-*): pictures with a name that a member earns, holds and shows on their directory card. Not itself a Trust Task specification (the `_shared` folder is skipped by the registry build and the codegen).

A COMMUNITY BADGE IS A BADGE GROUP. A badge of kind `community` is backed by exactly one community group (vtc/groups/*), referenced by `groupId` here and by `badgeId` on the group: its owners are the group's managers, its holders the group's members, and the group's own DID issues its holders the badge credential (VTI-BDG-010, VTI-BDG-011, VTI-BDG-060). A badge group never carries authority (VTI-BDG-012). A badge of kind `kudos` has no group and no credential (VTI-BDG-041).

AN AWARD IS AN OFFER UNTIL ACCEPTED. Giving a badge records an award in state `offered`; nothing is admitted, issued or shown until the recipient accepts (VTI-BDG-020, VTI-BDG-021). Each giving of a repeatable or kudos badge is an award of its own (VTI-BDG-022, VTI-BDG-041).

BADGES CONFER NOTHING. The community never reads a badge, an award or a badge credential in an authorization decision (VTI-BDG-002).

BadgeId.title: BadgeId
BadgeId.description: Opaque identifier of a badge: `bdg_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters. Random, community-scoped, never reused (VTI-BDG-001).

AwardId.title: AwardId
AwardId.description: Opaque identifier of one giving of a badge to one member: `awd_` followed by 16 to 64 base64url characters. Random and unique within the community.

BadgeKind.title: BadgeKind
BadgeKind.description: `community`: defined by holders of `vtc.badges.admin`, given by its owners (its badge group's managers), may carry a credential. `kudos`: made by a member the community's badge settings admit, given by any active member to any other, never a credential. Fixed for the badge's life; a kudos badge becomes a community badge only by promotion (vtc/badges/promote).

BadgeName.title: BadgeName
BadgeName.description: The badge's name, shown on the wall and written into the credential's Achievement. Plain text; a reader MUST NOT treat it as instructions.

BadgeDescription.title: BadgeDescription
BadgeDescription.description: What the badge is for. Plain text; a reader MUST NOT treat it as instructions.

BadgeCriteria.title: BadgeCriteria
BadgeCriteria.description: How the badge is earned, shown to members and written into the credential's Achievement as its criteria narrative. Plain text.

BadgeState.title: BadgeState
BadgeState.description: `active`: may be given and shown. `retired`: kept for its holders' own history, never given, never shown to members who do not hold it (VTI-BDG-005).

AwardNote.title: AwardNote
AwardNote.description: What the award is for, from the giver, shown to the recipient and written as the award's evidence narrative where the badge carries a credential. Plain text; erased with its author (VTI-BDG-090).

AwardState.title: AwardState
AwardState.description: `offered`: waiting for the recipient. `accepted`: the recipient took it; for a community badge the credential was issued and the membership recorded. `declined`: the recipient declined; nothing was recorded in the group and nothing issued. `withdrawn`: the giver withdrew the offer before a decision. `expired`: the offer lapsed unanswered. `revoked`: taken back after acceptance (VTI-BDG-023).

Badge.title: Badge
Badge.description: A badge as a caller who may see it sees it. `groupId` is present exactly when `kind` is `community`. `holderCount` only to callers who may see the badge's holders, counted over holders who have not hidden it (VTI-BDG-030, VTI-BDG-033). `createdBy` is the directory entry of the administrator or member who made it, where they have one.

image.description: The badge's picture, re-encoded and stored by the community (vtc/badges/images/upload), read with vtc/badges/images/get. `url` and `urlExpiresAt` MAY appear in a projection as for a card picture; for a badge whose holders may show it outside, `url` MAY be the picture's stable public location.

repeatable.description: Whether one member may hold the badge more than once, each giving an award of its own (VTI-BDG-022). Always true for a kudos badge.

requestable.description: Community badges only. Whether a member may ask for it: a request to join its badge group, decided by its owners (VTI-BDG-014). Absent reads as false.

listed.description: Whether members who do not hold the badge see it in the community's badge list. An unlisted badge is seen by its holders, its owners and administrators.

shareableOutside.description: Community badges only. Whether its holders may show it outside the community, which decides the credential's regime: short-lived and renewed with no status when false, long-lived with a status in the community's own status set when true (VTI-BDG-061, VTI-BDG-062). Absent reads as false.

groupId.description: The badge group that backs a community badge: its managers are the badge's owners, its members the holders, its DID the credential's issuer.

holderCount.description: Holders who show the badge. Only to callers who may see the holders.

ext.description: Ecosystem-defined extension members per SPEC.md §4.5.1. An extension member MUST NOT carry authority.

AwardShare.title: AwardShare
AwardShare.description: Where an accepted award is shown outside the community, by its holder's choice (VTI-BDG-070): the public location that answers a verification of exactly what the credential says, the baked image where the community serves one, and since when. Present only while the holder shares the award; absent once they stop, the award is taken back, the badge is retired or the holder departs. The locations are unguessable and name no other holder (VTI-BDG-071).

verificationUrl.description: The public location that answers the credential and a verification of it.

bakedImageUrl.description: The badge's picture with the credential baked into it, for a website or an email signature. Absent where the community serves no baked image.

Award.title: Award
Award.description: One giving of a badge to one member. `givenBy` is the giver's directory entry, absent for an award a dynamic badge group's rule made. `note` is shown to the recipient, the giver, the badge's owners and administrators, never to other members. `credentialId` is present on an accepted award of a community badge: the badge credential that evidences it, renewed or re-issued as the badge's regime requires. `shared` is present on an accepted award of a badge its holders may show outside while its holder shares it (vtc/badges/awards/share).

decidedAt.description: When the recipient accepted or declined, the giver withdrew, the offer expired, or the award was revoked.

expiresAt.description: When an unanswered offer lapses, where the community expires offers.

WallVisibility.title: WallVisibility
WallVisibility.description: Who sees a member's badges, the member's own setting (VTI-BDG-031). `members`: every active member the directory shows their card to. `nobody`: no one but the member. Never wider than the directory shows the card.

WallEntry.title: WallEntry
WallEntry.description: One badge on a member's wall as a viewer sees it: the badge, how many times the member holds it, since when, and whether the member pinned it. Hidden badges are never wall entries (VTI-BDG-030).

count.description: Accepted awards of this badge the member holds.

since.description: When the member first accepted this badge.

latestAt.description: When the member last accepted an award of this badge.

MyBadge.title: MyBadge
MyBadge.description: A badge as its holder sees it in their own list: the wall entry plus what only the holder knows — whether they hid it, their position for it, and the credential that evidences it.

hidden.description: The holder hid it: off their wall, out of the badge's holder list for members, out of its count; the awards, the membership and the credential stand (VTI-BDG-030).

position.description: The holder's order on their wall, lowest first.

KudosMakers.title: KudosMakers
KudosMakers.description: Who may make a kudos badge (VTI-BDG-004). `nobody`: no kudos badges. `roles`: holders of any of `roles`, or members of any of `groups`. `members`: every active member.

roles.description: Community role names. Read exactly when `policy` is `roles`.

BadgeLimits.title: BadgeLimits
BadgeLimits.description: The community's bounds (VTI-BDG-032, VTI-BDG-040). Each has a default a community that states none applies.

kudosPerGiverPerDay.description: Kudos one member may give in a day. Default 10.

sameGiverSameMember.description: How often the same member may give a kudos badge to the same member: at most once a day, once a week, or without bound. Default `day`.

minTenureDays.description: Days of membership before a member may give kudos or make a kudos badge. Default 7.

kudosBadgesPerMakerPerMonth.description: Kudos badges one member may make in a calendar month. Default 5.

maxPinned.description: Badges a member may pin beside their name. Default 2.

offerExpiresAfterDays.description: Days an unanswered offer stands before it expires. Absent: offers do not expire.

BadgeSettings.title: BadgeSettings
BadgeSettings.description: The community's badge settings (VTI-BDG-004). `enabled` false hides every badge surface and keeps every record; nothing is given or issued while it is false.

showKudosTotals.description: Whether a member's kudos total is shown on their card (VTI-BDG-043).

automaticBadges.description: Whether dynamic badge groups are computed (VTI-BDG-013). False: a community badge may not be created on a dynamic group, and existing ones are not recomputed.

membersMayRequest.description: Whether any community badge may be marked `requestable`. False: every badge group is closed.

credentialValidDays.description: Validity of a badge credential its holders may show outside (VTI-BDG-062). Default 730.
